title: 第016章 上古修真者第017章 龙阳山庄

;;
一股吸力，试图要把秦延军吸进风云之中，这让师姐师兄，还有秦雨水等人大惊！
秦延军似乎感觉到了大家的紧张，运转功法稳住自己，随后大声喊道：“师兄师姐，水叔，不要紧张！”
听了秦延军的话，大家怎么可能不紧张？
上古修真者乃是大能，如果小师弟出了事，怎么跟师傅交代？
秦延军见大家还是一脸担忧，咬了咬牙，运转体内更多的灵力对抗那股吸力。就在这时，风云中突然伸出一只巨大的黑色手掌，朝着秦延军抓来。
秦延军心中一凛，急忙侧身闪躲。
这么一躲闪，那只黑色手掌抓了一空。
秦延军手上不知何时多了一把形状怪异的刀，一刀砍向了那只黑色手掌。
刀光闪过，黑色手掌竟未被砍断，反而那股吸力陡然增强，秦延军一个踉跄，差点被吸过去。就在这千钧一发之际，他体内的灵力疯狂涌动，在身前形成一道灵力护盾，暂时抵挡住了吸力。
那只黑色手掌再次抓来，秦延军灵活地跳跃躲闪，同时不断挥刀攻击。然而，手掌似乎有灵性一般，总能预判他的动作。
突然，风云中传来一阵低沉的怒吼，紧接着又伸出几只黑色手掌，将秦延军团团围住。秦延军心中暗叫不好，他运转功法，准备施展更强的法术。就在这时，师姐突然喊道：“小师弟，用我们的灵力！”说着，师姐、师兄和秦雨水一同将灵力注入秦延军体内。
秦延军感受到这股强大的力量，眼中闪过一丝坚定。他大喝一声，将灵力与手中的怪刀融合，化作一道巨大的刀芒，朝着那些黑色手掌斩去。刀芒所过之处，黑色手掌纷纷消散，吸力也随之减弱。
就在众人以为暂时安全时，风云中传出一阵阴森的冷笑：“有点本事，但还远远不够。”
紧接着，风云急剧旋转，形成一个巨大的黑洞，一股更为恐怖的吸力从黑洞中传来，之前的吸力与之相比，简直是小巫见大巫。
秦延军等人的灵力护盾在这股吸力下摇摇欲坠。秦延军咬着牙，额头青筋暴起，他知道这是生死存亡的关键时刻。
突然，他脑海中灵光一闪，想起师傅曾传授的一种禁忌秘法。虽然使用此秘法会对自身造成极大的损伤，但此时已别无他法。
秦延军心一横，运转起禁忌秘法。他身上的气息瞬间变得狂暴起来，手中怪刀光芒大盛，他高高跃起，将全身灵力汇聚于刀上，朝着黑洞狠狠斩去。刀芒如同一道璀璨的流星，划破黑暗，直逼黑洞中心。
只听“轰”的一声巨响，黑洞被斩破，风云渐渐消散。秦延军却因秘法的反噬，一口鲜血喷出，身体摇摇欲坠。师姐、师兄和秦雨水急忙上前将他扶住。
云金刚和云梦蝶看到这一幕，简直毁了自己的三观，世上还有这么离奇的事情？

云梦蝶看见秦延军口喷鲜血，眼泪在眼中直打转，踉踉跄跄的冲了过去：“延军，你没事吧？”
秦延军听见云梦蝶的声音，缓缓睁开眼说道：“云小姐，我没事。”
这时候，上古修真者缓缓开口说道：“小友，多谢你的帮助，刚才你使用了秘法，对你的身体有一些影响。我这里有一枚洗髓丹，等你伤势复原之后，可以服下。此丹，洗涤精脉，可以让你日后的修炼更加的快速，灵根也能够得到提升。”
秦延军有些虚弱的说道：“多谢前辈，此恩记在我心中。”
上古修真者平静无波的说道：“今日，为了我的脱困，大家都出了力，在此谢谢大家。”然后手一挥，所有人都感觉到了自己突然恢复了，而且比之前更有了精神，实力也有所提升。
大家齐齐一抱拳：“多谢前辈！”
上古修真者哈哈一笑：“今日，在此遇见也是一种缘分。我名为‘玄机子’，如果有缘，今后自会相见，我在上界等着诸位。”
说完，白光一闪，不见了踪影。
看到‘玄机子’已经没了踪影，大家才回过神来。
云梦蝶关心道：“延军，你好些了吗？”
秦延军感觉到云梦蝶的爱意，心想；“都叫我的名字了，是不是发展的太快了？不管了，就顺其自然吧！既然她都叫我的名字，那我也叫她的名字吧！”
想到这里，说道：“梦蝶，谢谢你的关心，我已经好多了。”说完便站了起来。
几位师兄师姐，秦雨水，云金刚几人看到他们两人眼神中都有了对方，而且还叫得那么亲昵，都暗自高兴着。
林晓晓和几位服务员，早已惊得目瞪口呆，直到看见秦延军站了起来，这才回过神来。
急忙招呼大家：“各位贵宾，都请入座吧！由于今天出现了意外状况，所有消费打五折。”
吴茉莉说道：“打折就算了，到时候其他股东会有意见的，算在我头上就行！”
众人入座后，气氛逐渐轻松起来。吴茉莉笑着说道：“这一顿饭可真是太难忘了，经历了这么离奇的事，咱们更得好好吃好喝好。”说话间，服务员陆续上了菜和酒。
云金刚举起酒杯，爽朗地说：“今日大家齐心协力帮玄机子前辈脱困，还都提升了实力，这是大喜之事，来，干一杯！”众人纷纷举杯，一饮而尽。
秦延军和云梦蝶挨着坐，两人时不时眼神交汇，脸上都泛起红晕。师姐看着他们，打趣道：“延军，梦蝶，你们这进展可真快啊，可要好好相处。”引得众人一阵欢笑。
酒过三巡，菜过五味，秦延军感觉身上的伤势恢复了不少，心中对未来的修炼也充满了期待。他暗暗发誓，一定要尽快恢复，服下洗髓丹，提升实力。

此时，包间里充满了欢声笑语，大家在这都市的喧嚣中，共同经历了一场奇幻的修真事件，而这份独特的经历，也将成为他们人生中难忘的回忆。
这一次接风宴，让大家都见识了修真世界的玄幻。
宴会即将结束的时候，吴茉莉说道：“今天这件事，希望大家都烂在肚子里，如果传出了外界，会引发不可想象的事情发生。林晓晓，希望你们几名服务员，把这件事烂在肚子里。”
一顿接风宴，让大家都开了眼界，但是又不可以传扬出去。宴会，也像其他的聚会一样各回各家，各找各妈。

A suction force tried to suck Qin Yanjun into the storm, which shocked the senior sisters and brothers, as well as Qin Yuyu and others!
Qin Yanjun seemed to feel everyone's nervousness. He used his exercises to stabilize himself, and then shouted loudly: "Brother and sister, Uncle Shui, don't be nervous!"
After listening to Qin Yanjun's words, how could everyone not be nervous?
Ancient cultivators were powerful. If something happened to my junior brother, how would he explain it to his master?
Seeing that everyone still looked worried, Qin Yanjun gritted his teeth and used more spiritual power in his body to resist the suction. At this moment, a huge black palm suddenly stretched out from the wind and cloud and grabbed Qin Yanjun.
Qin Yanjun's heart trembled, and he hurriedly dodged sideways.
With such a dodge, the black palm grabbed everything.
Qin Yanjun didn't know when a strange-shaped knife appeared in his hand, and he slashed at the black palm.
The sword flashed, but the black palm was not cut off. Instead, the suction force suddenly increased. Qin Yanjun staggered and was almost sucked in. At this critical moment, the spiritual power in his body surged crazily, forming a spiritual shield in front of him, temporarily resisting the suction force.
The black palm was grabbed again. Qin Yanjun jumped and dodged flexibly while constantly swinging his knife to attack. However, the palms seemed to be spiritual and could always predict his movements.
Suddenly, a low roar came from the wind and clouds, and then several black palms stretched out to surround Qin Yan's army. Qin Yanjun secretly screamed in his heart, and he activated his skills and prepared to cast stronger spells. At this moment, the senior sister suddenly shouted: "Junior brother, use our spiritual power!" With that, the senior sister, senior brother and Qin Yuu poured spiritual power into Qin Yanjun's body.
Qin Yanjun felt this powerful force, and a trace of determination flashed in his eyes. He shouted loudly, fused his spiritual power with the strange knife in his hand, and turned it into a huge sword light, slashing towards those black palms. Wherever the sword light passed, the black palms dissipated one after another, and the suction force also weakened.
Just when everyone thought they were safe for the time being, a sinister sneer came from the storm: "A bit capable, but not enough."
Immediately afterwards, the wind and clouds rotated sharply, forming a huge black hole, and an even more terrifying suction force came from the black hole. Compared with the previous suction force, it was simply insignificant.
The spiritual shields of Qin Yanjun and others were crumbling under this suction force. Qin Yanjun gritted his teeth and veins popped up on his forehead. He knew that this was a critical moment of life and death.
Suddenly, an idea flashed in his mind, and he remembered a forbidden secret technique once taught by his master. Although using this secret method will cause great damage to oneself, there is no other way at this time.
Qin Yanjun's heart was filled with excitement, and he activated the forbidden secret method. The aura on his body instantly became violent, and the strange knife in his hand glowed brightly. He jumped up high, concentrated all his spiritual power on the knife, and slashed towards the black hole. The sword light was like a bright meteor, cutting through the darkness and reaching the center of the black hole.
Just hearing a loud "boom", the black hole was cut open, and the storm gradually dissipated. However, due to the backlash of the secret technique, Qin Yanjun spurted out a mouthful of blood and his body was shaking. Senior sister, senior brother and Qin Yuyu hurriedly stepped forward to support him.
When Yun Jingang and Yun Mengdie saw this scene, their views were completely ruined. Is there such a bizarre thing in the world?
Yun Mengdie saw Qin Yanjun spurting blood from his mouth, tears welling up in his eyes, and he staggered over and rushed over: "Yanjun, are you okay?"
Qin Yanjun heard Yun Mengdie's voice, slowly opened his eyes and said, "Miss Yun, I'm fine."
At this time, the ancient cultivator slowly said: "My friend, thank you for your help. You used a secret method just now, which had some impact on your body. I have a marrow-cleansing pill here, which you can take after you recover from your injury. This pill can cleanse your essence veins and make your future cultivation faster, and your spiritual roots can also be improved."
Qin Yanjun said weakly: "Thank you, senior, this favor is in my heart. "
The ancient cultivator said calmly: "Today, everyone has contributed to my escape, and I would like to thank you all. "Then with a wave of his hand, everyone felt that they suddenly recovered, and they were more energetic and stronger than before.
Everyone clasped their fists together: "Thank you, senior! "
The ancient cultivator laughed: "Today, meeting here is also a kind of fate. My name is 'Xuanjizi'. If we are destined, we will meet each other in the future. I am waiting for you in the upper world. "
After saying that, the white light flashed and disappeared.
Everyone came back to their senses when they saw that 'Xuanjizi' had disappeared.
Yun Mengdie asked with concern: "Yanjun, are you feeling better? "
Qin Yanjun felt Yun Mengdie's love and thought to himself, "Everyone calls me by my name. Is it going too fast? No matter what, just let nature take its course! Since she calls me by my name, let me call her by her name too! "
Thinking of this, he said: "Mengdie, thank you for your concern, I am much better now. "After saying that, he stood up.
Senior brothers and sisters, Qin Yuyu, Yun Jingang and others were secretly happy when they saw that the two of them had each other in their eyes and were calling each other so affectionately.
Lin Xiaoxiao and several waiters were stunned for a long time. They didn't come back to their senses until they saw Qin Yanjun standing up.
He hurriedly greeted everyone: "Dear guests, please take your seats! Due to unexpected circumstances today, all purchases are 50% off. "
Wu Moli said: "Forget it about the discount. Other shareholders will have opinions when the time comes, so just blame it on me! "
After everyone took their seats, the atmosphere gradually became more relaxed. Wu Moli said with a smile: "This meal is really unforgettable. After experiencing such a bizarre thing, we have to eat and drink well. "While talking, the waiter served food and wine one after another.
Yun Jingang raised his glass and said cheerfully: "Today we all worked together to help senior Xuanjizi get out of trouble, and we all improved our strength. This is a great event, come and have a drink! "Everyone raised their glasses and drank it all.
Qin Yanjun and Yun Mengdie sat next to each other. Their eyes met from time to time, with blushes on their faces. The senior sister looked at them and joked: "Yanjun, Mengdie, you guys are making really fast progress, so please get along well. ” caused everyone to burst into laughter.
After three rounds of wine and five tastes of food, Qin Yanjun felt that his injuries had recovered a lot, and he was full of expectations for his future cultivation. He secretly vowed to recover as soon as possible and take the Marrow Cleansing Pill to improve his strength.
At this time, the private room was filled with laughter and laughter. In the hustle and bustle of the city, everyone experienced a fantastic cultivation event together, and this unique experience will become an unforgettable memory in their lives.
This time, the Fengfeng Banquet allowed everyone to see the fantasy of the world of cultivation.
When the banquet was about to end, Wu Moli said: "I hope everyone will keep this matter in their stomachs today. If word spreads to the outside world, unimaginable things will happen. Lin Xiaoxiao, I hope you waiters will keep this matter in your stomach. "
A feast to welcome the wind opened everyone's eyes, but it could not be spread around. At the banquet, just like other gatherings, everyone goes back to their own homes to find their own mothers.
